docs/hooks.md:code-comment:toml:0350ab79.source: 数组中每项都必须匹配。
docs/hooks.md:code-comment:toml:0350ab79.translation: Every item in the array must match.

docs/hooks.md:code-comment:toml:74aa0440.source: Worker Hook 的 rules 不设置 action/actions；控制字段作为 event.handle 的默认值。
docs/hooks.md:code-comment:toml:74aa0440.translation: The rules of a Worker Hook do not set action/actions; control fields serve as the default value for event.handle.

docs/hooks.md:code-comment:toml:9ef9db7c.source: [[rules.actions]] 数组表，按声明顺序执行
docs/hooks.md:code-comment:toml:9ef9db7c.translation: [[rules.actions]] array table, executed in declaration order

docs/hooks.md:code-comment:toml:a524838b.source: 无需调用 Host 工具时，整个 [plugin.runtime.tools] 可省略。
docs/hooks.md:code-comment:toml:a524838b.translation: When there is no need to call Host tools, the entire [plugin.runtime.tools] can be omitted.

docs/hooks.md:code-comment:toml:ccc9ac5b.source: actions 数组，按数组顺序执行
docs/hooks.md:code-comment:toml:ccc9ac5b.translation: actions array, executed in array order

docs/hooks.md:heading:6c525747e75d3c07cf.source: 进程 Hook 编程接口

docs/hooks.md:list:00b41bf594925616f759a.source: 同一 response 同时返回 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 和 __ELBOT_CODE_1__ 时以 __ELBOT_CODE_2__ 为准。
docs/hooks.md:list:00b41bf594925616f759a.translation: When the same response returns both __ELBOT_CODE_0__ and __ELBOT_CODE_1__, __ELBOT_CODE_2__ takes precedence.

docs/hooks.md:list:0e4628deb5f2491a87a62.source: 需要继续收集输入时返回 __ELBOT_CODE_0__、__ELBOT_CODE_1__ 和 __ELBOT_CODE_2__：__ELBOT_CODE_3__ 必须晚于当前时间，剩余时间不超过 __ELBOT_CODE_4__。
docs/hooks.md:list:0e4628deb5f2491a87a62.translation: Return __ELBOT_CODE_0__, __ELBOT_CODE_1__, and __ELBOT_CODE_2__ when further input collection is required: __ELBOT_CODE_3__ must be later than the current time, and the remaining time must not exceed __ELBOT_CODE_4__.

docs/hooks.md:list:11cbf9318ed193d9a84a8.source: 三项阻断都是精确匹配、不支持通配符；__ELBOT_CODE_0__ 同时识别 __ELBOT_CODE_1__ 和 __ELBOT_CODE_2__ scope。
docs/hooks.md:list:11cbf9318ed193d9a84a8.translation: The three blocking items are all exact matches and do not support wildcards; __ELBOT_CODE_0__ recognizes both __ELBOT_CODE_1__ and __ELBOT_CODE_2__ scopes.

docs/hooks.md:list:1267da3b9e7b85fedb9d9.source: 匹配精确、不支持通配符；
docs/hooks.md:list:1267da3b9e7b85fedb9d9.translation: Exact matching; wildcards are not supported;

docs/hooks.md:list:1685373e36c090ee69b48.source: 独立插件在 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 的 __ELBOT_CODE_1__ 中配一次，对该插件全部规则和 Worker 生效。
docs/hooks.md:list:1685373e36c090ee69b48.translation: Independent plugins are configured once in __ELBOT_CODE_1__ of __ELBOT_CODE_0__, which applies to all rules and Workers of that plugin.

docs/hooks.md:list:172b8dcea25569dd7fbda.source: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 省略时用规则中的两个控制字段。
docs/hooks.md:list:172b8dcea25569dd7fbda.translation: When __ELBOT_CODE_0__ is omitted, the two control fields in the rule are used.

docs/hooks.md:list:1763c943001af906555b6.source: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ / __ELBOT_CODE_1__ 可以让 Hook 观察未唤起消息，但不会让主 LLM 自动处理它们；
docs/hooks.md:list:1763c943001af906555b6.translation: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ / __ELBOT_CODE_1__ allows Hooks to observe messages that did not trigger a wake-up, but it will not cause the main LLM to process them automatically;

docs/hooks.md:list:1afb8182c866497b73b13.source: 阻断策略命中、worker 退出、停止或重载会清理该插件租约。
docs/hooks.md:list:1afb8182c866497b73b13.translation: Blocking strategy hits, worker exits, stops, or reloads will clear the plugin lease.

docs/hooks.md:list:2331867a2af7a45bf2657.source: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 是事件已累积的输出快照，数组项用 Go 导出的 JSON 字段名，例如 __ELBOT_CODE_1__、__ELBOT_CODE_2__、__ELBOT_CODE_3__、__ELBOT_CODE_4__、__ELBOT_CODE_5__。
docs/hooks.md:list:2331867a2af7a45bf2657.translation: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ is the accumulated output snapshot of the event; array items use the JSON field names exported by Go, such as __ELBOT_CODE_1__, __ELBOT_CODE_2__, __ELBOT_CODE_3__, __ELBOT_CODE_4__, and __ELBOT_CODE_5__.

docs/hooks.md:list:243bbd53c9a8d3dd1be8b.source: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 保留平台归一化后的原始内容；处理文本指令时优先读已去除唤醒前缀的 __ELBOT_CODE_1__，为空再拼接 text segments。
docs/hooks.md:list:243bbd53c9a8d3dd1be8b.translation: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ preserves the original content after platform normalization; when processing text commands, prioritize reading __ELBOT_CODE_1__ with the wake-up prefix removed, and concatenate text segments if it is empty.

docs/hooks.md:list:249a75360882ef386dd2b.source: 续接的 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 用插件租约的 __ELBOT_CODE_1__，普通事件用平台会话 ID，不改写事件原始上下文。
docs/hooks.md:list:249a75360882ef386dd2b.translation: Resumed __ELBOT_CODE_0__ uses the plugin lease's __ELBOT_CODE_1__, while ordinary events use the platform Session ID, without rewriting the original event context.

docs/hooks.md:list:24f777ee46fdabcbcf371.source: 续接与后续普通规则的日志结果按执行顺序汇总；后续规则未匹配或成功，不会覆盖此前续接的失败或取消结果。
docs/hooks.md:list:24f777ee46fdabcbcf371.translation: Log results of the continuation and subsequent ordinary rules are aggregated in execution order; if subsequent rules are not matched or succeed, they will not override the previous failure or cancellation results of the continuation.

docs/hooks.md:list:270dcaa81b67f4ed521e5.source: key 去除首尾空白后必须非空，最长 256 字节。
docs/hooks.md:list:270dcaa81b67f4ed521e5.translation: The key must be non-empty after trimming leading and trailing whitespace, with a maximum length of 256 bytes.

docs/hooks.md:list:27f519f3e23881e446bc9.source: 用户或 pending 的 Hook 修改会在模型请求前写入会话历史；工具完成 Hook 的修改也写入 transcript。
docs/hooks.md:list:27f519f3e23881e446bc9.translation: Modifications by user or pending Hooks are written to the Session history before the model request; modifications by tool completion Hooks are also written to the transcript.

docs/hooks.md:list:286fa9252a98b8efcf585.source: 用户发送精确的 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 时，Host 取消该路由当前执行或 waiting 会话，并关闭 Transient Worker；
docs/hooks.md:list:286fa9252a98b8efcf585.translation: When the user sends an exact __ELBOT_CODE_0__, the Host cancels the current execution or waiting Session of that route and closes the Transient Worker;

docs/hooks.md:list:28bb0cc343443fd1b2a25.source: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 遇到已唤起消息直接跳过，不影响后续插件、命令或主 LLM。
docs/hooks.md:list:28bb0cc343443fd1b2a25.translation: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ skips messages that have already been awakened, without affecting subsequent plugins, commands, or the main LLM.

docs/hooks.md:list:28d01b9f2d4ced97f17ff.source: 插件返回 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 时，再从后续规则继续传播，最后可进入命令或主 LLM。
docs/hooks.md:list:28d01b9f2d4ced97f17ff.translation: When the plugin returns __ELBOT_CODE_0__, propagation continues from subsequent rules, and can finally enter a command or the main LLM.

docs/hooks.md:list:291421198b60407c884c1.source: 完成时返回 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 或省略 status。
docs/hooks.md:list:291421198b60407c884c1.translation: Return __ELBOT_CODE_0__ or omit status upon completion.

docs/hooks.md:list:2b8b990f0741ac436ba06.source: 改写会报错并停止该次 Hook，工具准备失败时以原 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 返回错误结果。
docs/hooks.md:list:2b8b990f0741ac436ba06.translation: Rewriting will cause an error and stop the current Hook; if tool preparation fails, the error result will be returned using the original __ELBOT_CODE_0__.

docs/hooks.md:list:328ade54bafe77de4de2d.source: 单个 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ JSON Lines 帧最大 16 MiB，不要内联大数据。
docs/hooks.md:list:328ade54bafe77de4de2d.translation: A single __ELBOT_CODE_0__ JSON Lines frame has a maximum size of 16 MiB; do not inline large data.

docs/hooks.md:list:343fe68f6abd6d2032b06.source: 实现每条路由只存一份租约；
docs/hooks.md:list:343fe68f6abd6d2032b06.translation: Ensuring that only one lease is stored per route;

docs/hooks.md:list:372ffa05b8b07cfa4e27d.source: Host 先将后续消息以 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 路由给持有租约的 Hook；
docs/hooks.md:list:372ffa05b8b07cfa4e27d.translation: The Host first routes subsequent messages to the Hook holding the lease via __ELBOT_CODE_0__;

docs/hooks.md:list:37c40c7700b5e8f340c46.source: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ / __ELBOT_CODE_1__ 只处理 text segment；图片和文件保留。
docs/hooks.md:list:37c40c7700b5e8f340c46.translation: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ / __ELBOT_CODE_1__ only process text segments; images and files are preserved.

docs/hooks.md:list:387cb5d79b90e3ba14ca0.source: 插件内所有规则（包括 exec action）、Worker trigger 和 waiting 路由统一用 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 的阻断配置。
docs/hooks.md:list:387cb5d79b90e3ba14ca0.translation: All rules within the plugin (including exec actions), Worker triggers, and waiting routes uniformly use the blocking configuration of __ELBOT_CODE_0__.

docs/hooks.md:list:3e6adf15538f5afacb00c.source: waiting 通过一次性定时器主动到期，不需要新消息或路由查询触发。
docs/hooks.md:list:3e6adf15538f5afacb00c.translation: `waiting` expires actively via a one-time timer, without requiring a new message or route query to trigger it.

docs/hooks.md:list:3f978bf24294ecd869216.source: 再次返回 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 则以新 ID、过期时间续期。
docs/hooks.md:list:3f978bf24294ecd869216.translation: Returning __ELBOT_CODE_0__ again will renew it with a new ID and expiration time.

docs/hooks.md:list:3fe1cdbff189a7530885e.source: 输入、展示文本和工具结果仍可改写。
docs/hooks.md:list:3fe1cdbff189a7530885e.translation: Input, display text, and tool results can still be rewritten.

docs/hooks.md:list:4160036a818ad38caabcc.source: value 必须是合法 JSON，压缩后单值最大 1 MiB；共享区最多 10,000 条，key 与 value 合计最大 32 MiB。
docs/hooks.md:list:4160036a818ad38caabcc.translation: The value must be valid JSON, with a maximum size of 1 MiB per value after compression; the shared area supports up to 10,000 entries, with a combined maximum size of 32 MiB for keys and values.

docs/hooks.md:list:43baa18d68254993ba1ee.source: continuation 放行后不会用同一条消息重新触发刚结束 waiting 的插件。
docs/hooks.md:list:43baa18d68254993ba1ee.translation: After the continuation is released, the plugin that just finished waiting will not be re-triggered by the same message.

docs/hooks.md:list:446778fa59b855c109c10.source: 空 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 表示立即发送，非 Hook 输出的来源字段为空。
docs/hooks.md:list:446778fa59b855c109c10.translation: An empty __ELBOT_CODE_0__ indicates immediate sending, and the source field of non-Hook output is empty.

docs/hooks.md:list:44aa3c37f1fb85e8f869e.source: 工具完成事件中 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 为 __ELBOT_CODE_1__，__ELBOT_CODE_2__ 是工具的原始多模态结果，__ELBOT_CODE_3__ 和 __ELBOT_CODE_4__ 标识工具与本次调用；
docs/hooks.md:list:44aa3c37f1fb85e8f869e.translation: In tool completion events, __ELBOT_CODE_0__ is __ELBOT_CODE_1__, __ELBOT_CODE_2__ is the original multimodal result of the tool, and __ELBOT_CODE_3__ and __ELBOT_CODE_4__ identify the tool and the current call;

docs/hooks.md:list:466aa0d464798377d59e7.source: Host 关闭 Hook runtime 时：停止接纳新的插件请求和取消通知、撤销 waiting 定时器、取消在途工具调用，并等待进程、插件请求、已登记的通知与定时回调、重载和资源清理实际结束。
docs/hooks.md:list:466aa0d464798377d59e7.translation: When the Host closes the Hook runtime: it stops accepting new plugin requests and cancellation notifications, revokes waiting timers, cancels in-flight tool calls, and waits for the process, plugin requests, registered notifications and timed callbacks, reloads, and resource cleanup to actually finish.

docs/hooks.md:list:4d32cb76f1e86737e4f2f.source: 根 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 解析失败会使本次规则配置加载失败；单个被引用插件配置有误时只跳过该插件，其他照常加载。TOML 采用严格字段校验，未知字段报错。
docs/hooks.md:list:4d32cb76f1e86737e4f2f.translation: A parsing failure of the root __ELBOT_CODE_0__ will cause the current rule configuration loading to fail; if a single referenced plugin is misconfigured, only that plugin will be skipped, and others will load as usual. TOML uses strict field validation, and unknown fields will trigger an error.

docs/hooks.md:list:4dc2ee9c6c8b3f45d7ee7.source: 停止时 Host 先请求 __ELBOT_CODE_0__；
docs/hooks.md:list:4dc2ee9c6c8b3f45d7ee7.translation: When stopping, the Host first requests __ELBOT_CODE_0__;

docs/hooks.md:list:502877a9131ddee6b91ec.source: 到期回调等待该路由执行结束后复核租约，旧回调不会删除续期或替换后的租约。
docs/hooks.md:list:502877a9131ddee6b91ec.translation: The expiration callback waits for the execution of the route to finish before re-verifying the lease; old callbacks will not delete renewed or replaced leases.

docs/hooks.md:list:526e0abac84acdcbc087a.source: 即使调用忽略取消，关闭等待超时也不会把它视为已退出。
docs/hooks.md:list:526e0abac84acdcbc087a.translation: Even if the call ignores cancellation, the shutdown wait timeout will not treat it as having exited.

docs/hooks.md:list:54456a19c6be3019f54eb.source: 插件规则误写这三个字段会出 warning，但插件仍正常加载、字段被忽略。
docs/hooks.md:list:54456a19c6be3019f54eb.translation: If these three fields are mistakenly written in a plugin rule, a warning will be triggered, but the plugin will still load normally and the fields will be ignored.

docs/hooks.md:list:5455421bbdd8a8c1bd48b.source: Persistent Worker 在没有协议写入故障时保留进程和内存。
docs/hooks.md:list:5455421bbdd8a8c1bd48b.translation: Persistent Workers retain processes and memory provided there are no protocol write failures.

docs/hooks.md:list:557fc0dba2fa2cc07c312.source: 若并发事件使多个 worker 同时竞争，最后写入者覆盖此前租约。
docs/hooks.md:list:557fc0dba2fa2cc07c312.translation: If concurrent events cause multiple workers to compete simultaneously, the last writer overrides the previous lease.

docs/hooks.md:list:5d23b6355e6e6f0e24cdf.source: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 当前只有 __ELBOT_CODE_1__ 的输出会真正延后，其他点仍立即发送。
docs/hooks.md:list:5d23b6355e6e6f0e24cdf.translation: Currently, only the output of __ELBOT_CODE_1__ in __ELBOT_CODE_0__ will be truly delayed; other points still send immediately.

docs/hooks.md:list:5e16b52e787e3beba99c0.source: 若在插件的 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 误写这三个字段，加载和 reload 会返回 warning 并忽略规则级字段，不会阻止插件运行。
docs/hooks.md:list:5e16b52e787e3beba99c0.translation: If these three fields are incorrectly written in the plugin's __ELBOT_CODE_0__, loading and reloading will return a warning and ignore the rule-level fields, but will not prevent the plugin from running.

docs/hooks.md:list:5ee7d56ba000cc29aa72e.source: 工具准备事件中的 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 和 __ELBOT_CODE_1__ 只读。
docs/hooks.md:list:5ee7d56ba000cc29aa72e.translation: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ and __ELBOT_CODE_1__ in tool preparation events are read-only.

docs/hooks.md:list:5fe1e1fc9d4e249198b68.source: __ELBOT_CODE_0__：只在工具流程下次请求前存在新 pending 时绑定该 pending；
docs/hooks.md:list:5fe1e1fc9d4e249198b68.translation: __ELBOT_CODE_0__: Binds to the pending only when a new pending exists before the next request in the tool flow;

docs/hooks.md:list:618b4023d218c820d4d35.source: 到期释放租约并关闭所属 Transient Worker，Persistent Worker 保留进程。
docs/hooks.md:list:618b4023d218c820d4d35.translation: Upon expiration, the lease is released and the associated Transient Worker is closed, while the Persistent Worker retains its process.

docs/hooks.md:list:66c3db202e4e147274bb8.source: 建议用 __ELBOT_CODE_0__、__ELBOT_CODE_1__ 等前缀避免冲突，但前缀不是权限边界。
docs/hooks.md:list:66c3db202e4e147274bb8.translation: It is recommended to use prefixes such as __ELBOT_CODE_0__ and __ELBOT_CODE_1__ to avoid conflicts, but prefixes are not security boundaries.

docs/hooks.md:list:6960103b5bc72f631c6d1.source: Responses 模型返回的调用集合、ID、名称和参数全部只读（Go Handler、规则和进程 Hook 都一样）；
docs/hooks.md:list:6960103b5bc72f631c6d1.translation: The call set, ID, name, and parameters returned by the Responses model are all read-only (the same applies to Go Handlers, rules, and process Hooks);

docs/hooks.md:list:6c2eaf42edef0b218ac26.source: 对于 transient worker，同时关闭该进程。
docs/hooks.md:list:6c2eaf42edef0b218ac26.translation: For transient workers, the process is closed simultaneously.

docs/hooks.md:list:6cd27c417e8a34939c56b.source: 插件源码、__ELBOT_CODE_0__ 和私有状态文件放 __ELBOT_CODE_1__；
docs/hooks.md:list:6cd27c417e8a34939c56b.translation: Plugin source code, __ELBOT_CODE_0__, and private state files are placed in __ELBOT_CODE_1__;

docs/hooks.md:list:6fffce04208e217dca2d4.source: 该限制保证本地执行与服务端已保存的 function call 一致。
docs/hooks.md:list:6fffce04208e217dca2d4.translation: This restriction ensures consistency between local execution and the function calls saved on the server.

docs/hooks.md:list:743d881e2a802118e5950.source: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ action 可在所有 Hook 点创建 output intent，但只有表中“outputs 会被发送”为“是”的点会消费它。
docs/hooks.md:list:743d881e2a802118e5950.translation: The __ELBOT_CODE_0__ action can create an output intent at all Hook points, but only points where "outputs will be sent" is "Yes" in the table will consume it.

docs/hooks.md:list:745e81e810224a4d0b822.source: 后台工具调用也受 runtime 关闭取消约束；
docs/hooks.md:list:745e81e810224a4d0b822.translation: Background tool calls are also subject to runtime shutdown cancellation constraints;

docs/hooks.md:list:7812d4218785251420ac7.source: __ELBOT_CODE_0__：绑定实际进入工具执行后产生的工具结果；预检失败、确认拒绝或启动前失败不触发。
docs/hooks.md:list:7812d4218785251420ac7.translation: __ELBOT_CODE_0__: Binds to the tool result generated after actually entering tool execution; not triggered by pre-check failure, confirmation rejection, or failure before startup.

docs/hooks.md:list:7821e93054a5b5623bea6.source: 阻断三项任一命中即不调用该插件规则或 __ELBOT_CODE_0__；
docs/hooks.md:list:7821e93054a5b5623bea6.translation: If any of the three blocking items match, the plugin rule or __ELBOT_CODE_0__ will not be called;

docs/hooks.md:list:788fc77f6e040922d8b91.source: 图片可用 HTTP(S) __ELBOT_CODE_0__、相对插件目录的 __ELBOT_CODE_1__，或最大 10 MiB 的 __ELBOT_CODE_2__；
docs/hooks.md:list:788fc77f6e040922d8b91.translation: Images can be provided via HTTP(S) __ELBOT_CODE_0__, __ELBOT_CODE_1__ relative to the plugin directory, or __ELBOT_CODE_2__ up to 10 MiB;

docs/hooks.md:list:843d16864dd6b440cbee6.source: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ / __ELBOT_CODE_1__ 改首个或最后一个 text segment；没有 text segment 时新增；图片和文件保留。
docs/hooks.md:list:843d16864dd6b440cbee6.translation: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ / __ELBOT_CODE_1__ modifies the first or last text segment; if no text segment exists, one is added; images and files are preserved.

docs/hooks.md:list:8457c2c31909fd8c86283.source: __ELBOT_CODE_0__、__ELBOT_CODE_1__、__ELBOT_CODE_2__：绑定本 turn 初始用户消息。
docs/hooks.md:list:8457c2c31909fd8c86283.translation: __ELBOT_CODE_0__, __ELBOT_CODE_1__, __ELBOT_CODE_2__: bound to the initial user message of this turn.

docs/hooks.md:list:8ac0e13bf64dde0ba90bf.source: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 是所有 Hook 共享文件的地方，不是插件目录、不会被扫描。
docs/hooks.md:list:8ac0e13bf64dde0ba90bf.translation: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ is the place for files shared by all Hooks; it is not a plugin directory and will not be scanned.

docs/hooks.md:list:8b024e60eda5fcdc3a423.source: waiting 租约也以该三元组为 key。
docs/hooks.md:list:8b024e60eda5fcdc3a423.translation: The waiting lease also uses this triplet as the key.

docs/hooks.md:list:96b372903206143d96f63.translation: Sending requests, waiting for responses, and graceful shutdown share a single __ELBOT_CODE_0__ budget; the process is forcibly killed immediately upon expiration.

docs/hooks.md:list:9de0df478500e54cab4d6.source: 插件新增输出时仍用“统一输出”章节的小写 segment 字段及组级 __ELBOT_CODE_0__、__ELBOT_CODE_1__。
docs/hooks.md:list:9de0df478500e54cab4d6.translation: When the plugin adds new output, it still uses the lowercase segment fields and group-level __ELBOT_CODE_0__ and __ELBOT_CODE_1__ from the "Unified Output" section.

docs/hooks.md:list:a1861650798e240ff0cef.source: 达到上限时先删过期项，再按最近使用时间淘汰最冷数据；__ELBOT_CODE_0__ 也可能被淘汰。

docs/hooks.md:list:aa0c2f9762eed8e409a20.source: 根规则空 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 会自动命名为 __ELBOT_CODE_1__，重名自动追加序号；不要依赖这个兼容行为。
docs/hooks.md:list:aa0c2f9762eed8e409a20.translation: An empty __ELBOT_CODE_0__ in the root rule will be automatically named __ELBOT_CODE_1__, and sequence numbers will be automatically appended in case of name collisions; do not rely on this compatibility behavior.

docs/hooks.md:list:acfbee7b3fec75a72b5a3.source: exec response 的 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 覆写只替换 text segment，原图片和文件 segment 保留。

docs/hooks.md:list:b283cb33f4f5925c8bd08.translation: A timeout return from the close call does not mean the process has exited.

docs/hooks.md:list:b7f0090fe1f9cce758642.translation: Relative paths for media are resolved according to the plugin directory of the declared rules; the rules for root __ELBOT_CODE_0__ are relative to __ELBOT_CODE_1__.

docs/hooks.md:list:baeab4d5f9a7274d1cab1.source: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 在两种 actions 形式中都可用。
docs/hooks.md:list:baeab4d5f9a7274d1cab1.translation: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ is available in both actions forms.

docs/hooks.md:list:be7ab91673eed13c6a3aa.translation: The same __ELBOT_CODE_0__ is executed serially within the same worker, while different routes can be executed in parallel.

docs/hooks.md:list:c0def3e1535ccb7f7b612.translation: The top level of __ELBOT_CODE_0__ contains __ELBOT_CODE_1__, __ELBOT_CODE_2__, __ELBOT_CODE_3__, __ELBOT_CODE_4__, __ELBOT_CODE_5__, __ELBOT_CODE_6__, __ELBOT_CODE_7__, __ELBOT_CODE_8__, __ELBOT_CODE_9__, __ELBOT_CODE_10__, __ELBOT_CODE_11__, and __ELBOT_CODE_12__;

docs/hooks.md:list:c3dfdadbd463e85fb4f57.source: 共享状态跨 Hook 重启和 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 保留，ElBot 重启后清空；需要持久化时写入插件目录或 __ELBOT_CODE_1__。
docs/hooks.md:list:c3dfdadbd463e85fb4f57.translation: Shared state is preserved across Hook restarts and __ELBOT_CODE_0__, but is cleared after an ElBot restart; for persistence, write to the plugin directory or __ELBOT_CODE_1__.

docs/hooks.md:list:c4be43a3d334684f4e893.source: 协议请求编码由客户端完成。
docs/hooks.md:list:c4be43a3d334684f4e893.translation: Protocol request encoding is completed by the client.

docs/hooks.md:list:c5ff740f190130af5f23a.source: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 和失败的 CAS 不刷新时间，过期 key 视为不存在。
docs/hooks.md:list:c5ff740f190130af5f23a.translation: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ and failed CAS operations do not refresh the time; expired keys are treated as non-existent.

docs/hooks.md:list:c72588c1db6a005822e58.source: 大媒体应写入插件目录或 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 后返回 __ELBOT_CODE_1__ 或 __ELBOT_CODE_2__；
docs/hooks.md:list:c72588c1db6a005822e58.translation: Large media files should be written to the plugin directory or __ELBOT_CODE_0__, then return __ELBOT_CODE_1__ or __ELBOT_CODE_2__;

docs/hooks.md:list:c8aa19094b7370c9f0cb0.source: 正常串行分发中，首个返回 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 的 worker 持有该路由，后续 worker trigger rule 不会再分发该路由。
docs/hooks.md:list:c8aa19094b7370c9f0cb0.translation: In normal serial distribution, the first worker to return __ELBOT_CODE_0__ holds the route, and subsequent worker trigger rules will no longer distribute this route.

docs/hooks.md:list:cbf0144d16e7dce949023.source: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 是只读的业务工具定义数组，每项含 __ELBOT_CODE_1__、__ELBOT_CODE_2__、__ELBOT_CODE_3__，不含某个 API 的工具包装；
docs/hooks.md:list:cbf0144d16e7dce949023.translation: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ is a read-only business tool definition array, where each item contains __ELBOT_CODE_1__, __ELBOT_CODE_2__, and __ELBOT_CODE_3__, but does not include the tool wrapper for a specific API;

docs/hooks.md:list:d244ae8858be4e3ee9bed.source: 与当前 Hook 点无关的字段会是零值、空对象或被省略，插件必须按可空值处理。
docs/hooks.md:list:d244ae8858be4e3ee9bed.translation: Fields unrelated to the current Hook point will be zero values, empty objects, or omitted; plugins must handle them as nullable values.

docs/hooks.md:list:d5dd657234ae122ff0f08.source: 阻断范围：直接写在根 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 的规则各自配置；
docs/hooks.md:list:d5dd657234ae122ff0f08.translation: Blocking scope: configured individually for rules written directly in the root __ELBOT_CODE_0__;

docs/hooks.md:list:d6e546027a65015685c3f.source: 取消通知异步发送，不阻塞原调用返回；若通知自身写入阻塞至超时，同样按协议写入故障结束该进程。
docs/hooks.md:list:d6e546027a65015685c3f.translation: Cancellation notifications are sent asynchronously and do not block the return of the original call; if the notification write itself blocks until timeout, the process will be terminated by writing a failure according to the protocol.

docs/hooks.md:list:d6e868ceeab0118ae62dd.source: 无 pending 时不提供可编辑消息，不能再次修改本 turn 初始输入。
docs/hooks.md:list:d6e868ceeab0118ae62dd.translation: No editable message is provided when there is no pending; the initial input of the current turn cannot be modified again.

docs/hooks.md:list:dd7dceee27ed50f24ee8c.source: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 修改 LLM 输入和会话历史；__ELBOT_CODE_1__ 创建发送到平台的输出意图，两者不互相转换。
docs/hooks.md:list:dd7dceee27ed50f24ee8c.translation: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ modifies the LLM input and Session history; __ELBOT_CODE_1__ creates an output intent to be sent to the platform; the two are not interchangeable.

docs/hooks.md:list:e25c1a384d43ad46e50e3.source: Worker trigger rule 复用规则 Hook 的匹配、角色、priority、__ELBOT_CODE_0__、__ELBOT_CODE_1__ 和 __ELBOT_CODE_2__；
docs/hooks.md:list:e25c1a384d43ad46e50e3.translation: Worker trigger rules reuse the matching, role, priority, __ELBOT_CODE_0__, __ELBOT_CODE_1__, and __ELBOT_CODE_2__ of rule Hooks;

docs/hooks.md:list:e365dd62969d2e6b8520b.source: Chat 的 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 可改写，实际参数会在工具执行前写回调用头，并用于执行和后续请求。
docs/hooks.md:list:e365dd62969d2e6b8520b.translation: The __ELBOT_CODE_0__ of Chat can be rewritten; the actual parameters will be written back to the call header before the tool is executed and used for execution and subsequent requests.

docs/hooks.md:list:e89ca3e4600d0bec232f6.source: 内联 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 的参数字段也是 __ELBOT_CODE_1__，不是 __ELBOT_CODE_2__。
docs/hooks.md:list:e89ca3e4600d0bec232f6.translation: The parameter field of an inline __ELBOT_CODE_0__ is also __ELBOT_CODE_1__, not __ELBOT_CODE_2__.

docs/hooks.md:list:ec71e81e47db0abbfc0f9.source: waiting 存在时优先处理续接，续接放行后执行普通 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 规则；
docs/hooks.md:list:ec71e81e47db0abbfc0f9.translation: When `waiting` exists, continuation is processed with priority; after continuation is allowed, ordinary __ELBOT_CODE_0__ rules are executed;

docs/hooks.md:list:ecaeb2c7bb65cb255c60d.translation: path/base64 will be normalized into a data URL readable by the model.

docs/hooks.md:list:ef61b3996a2da01b83506.source: 最终 assistant 文本通常先经 __ELBOT_CODE_0__，再经 __ELBOT_CODE_1__。
docs/hooks.md:list:ef61b3996a2da01b83506.translation: The final assistant text usually passes through __ELBOT_CODE_0__ first, and then through __ELBOT_CODE_1__.

docs/hooks.md:list:f00bd0115b6f4cdfd5641.source: 纯文本只保存 __ELBOT_CODE_0__，含图片等非文本内容时额外保存完整 segments。
docs/hooks.md:list:f00bd0115b6f4cdfd5641.translation: Plain text only saves __ELBOT_CODE_0__; when non-text content such as images is included, complete segments are saved additionally.

docs/hooks.md:list:f5b1dd84534dcd8e4b6b9.source: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 始终保留平台原文，不随 segments 修改。
docs/hooks.md:list:f5b1dd84534dcd8e4b6b9.translation: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ always retains the original platform text and is not modified by segments.

docs/hooks.md:list:f7621e5554dc7c5ddd8fc.translation: The corresponding worker trigger rule will not be triggered again.

docs/hooks.md:paragraph:05e4b90b8c61f6bb.translation: **Does not execute ElBot's risk grading, permission policies, or interaction confirmations**.

docs/hooks.md:paragraph:06473d882cc10af3.source: 每个元素分别渲染模板，不经过 shell。

docs/hooks.md:paragraph:0796d068201dcdff.translation: stdout can only be used to write the protocol; logs should be written to stderr.

docs/hooks.md:paragraph:0feeca5eb71611b7.translation: Worker Hooks can handle multiple events and receive __ELBOT_CODE_0__.

docs/hooks.md:paragraph:1d27e390aeee4e5e.translation: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ requires the following fields when __ELBOT_CODE_1__ or __ELBOT_CODE_2__;

docs/hooks.md:paragraph:22bb0550762804cd.translation: Hooks do not load interactive Shell initializations such as __ELBOT_CODE_0__, __ELBOT_CODE_1__, mise/asdf, etc.

docs/hooks.md:paragraph:27cb04fad0c86d6e.source: 命名的 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ / __ELBOT_CODE_1__ action 可供后续 action 引用：__ELBOT_CODE_2__、__ELBOT_CODE_3__。

docs/hooks.md:paragraph:2e0623d536e69e41.translation: The continuous read loop should distribute responses by request ID, or requests should be sent from event worker threads.

docs/hooks.md:paragraph:2f3d135738995b32.translation: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ is the tool text result, __ELBOT_CODE_1__ is a __ELBOT_CODE_2__ array, __ELBOT_CODE_3__ is a string array, and __ELBOT_CODE_4__ is the platform message ID after the tool outputs are sent via the Output Manager.

docs/hooks.md:paragraph:326fd05aec0fc106.translation: When the adapter returns JSON, the Host places it as-is into response __ELBOT_CODE_0__; otherwise, it is treated as a string.

docs/hooks.md:paragraph:34962d1527a20447.source: 没有有效 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 时必须给显式 __ELBOT_CODE_1__。
docs/hooks.md:paragraph:34962d1527a20447.translation: When there is no valid __ELBOT_CODE_0__, an explicit __ELBOT_CODE_1__ must be provided.

docs/hooks.md:paragraph:3819b4d302d35485.translation: A complete round-trip of a one-time exec Hook; each line in the code block is a JSON Lines frame.

docs/hooks.md:paragraph:3ae4bb09e4ac2cbb.source: 实际写入期间取消、超时或写入失败时，Host 会关闭该进程的 stdin 并结束其完整进程树，避免继续使用不完整的协议流。
docs/hooks.md:paragraph:3ae4bb09e4ac2cbb.translation: If a cancellation, timeout, or write failure occurs during the actual writing process, the Host will close the stdin of that process and terminate its entire process tree to avoid continuing to use an incomplete protocol stream.

docs/hooks.md:paragraph:46a0db842885d6ca.translation: Worker Hooks are declared by the plugin's own __ELBOT_CODE_0__.
